sourceRefs.locator: No. 1, pp. 1–2: opening list of protected people and church property; injunction on ring-sealed episcopal letters for captives taken under the king’s peace and the truth of petitions.
BK 1, Date and Transmission. Boretius dates the royal letter 507–511; the manuscripts place it in the canonical tradition.
pp. 139–141: Gregory’s story about taking hay in Touraine, compared with the orders described in the royal letter.

note.de: Der König erinnert an Befehle für den Feldzug und verlangt ein gesiegeltes Schreiben für bestimmte Fälle. Der Ausstellungsort bleibt offen.
note.en: The king recalls orders given for the campaign and requires a sealed letter in certain cases. The place of issue remains open.
